Description: Optional read-only synthetic inventory tool for AgentCore Gateway console practice, with encrypted logs and environment variables. No authentication code.

SecurityDesign.Invocation: Synchronous Gateway tool returning in-memory synthetic inventory. Reassess the function-level DLQ and VPC exceptions if adding asynchronous triggers, private resources or real business data.
SecurityDesign.Encryption: One rotating, stack-managed symmetric KMS key protects this demo's logs and server-side Lambda environment encryption. Lambda creates its environment encryption grant using the deployment principal's permissions; the handler does not call KMS.
SecurityDesign.Deployment: The deployment principal needs KMS key-management permissions, kms:DescribeKey to associate encrypted logs, and kms:CreateGrant/kms:Encrypt for Lambda. Customer-managed KMS charges apply. Five reserved executions require sufficient account concurrency quota.

Metadata.SecurityDesign: Resource '*' in this key policy means only the key to which the policy is attached. The account-root statement enables IAM delegation and key administration; it does not grant the Lambda role kms:*. CloudWatch Logs cryptographic use is restricted to this exact log group's encryption context.

Properties.Description: Encryption for the synthetic inventory demo logs and Lambda environment

Metadata.SecurityDesign: KMS ViaService names use the .amazonaws.com suffix in all partitions, as documented by KMS; the regional Logs principal uses AWS::URLSuffix. Key data permissions require both the regional Logs service and this exact log group's encryption context. The role has no key-management or direct environment-decryption permissions.

skip.comment: Gateway uses this read-only tool synchronously and receives the result or error directly. This stack defines no asynchronous trigger; Lambda DLQs capture failed asynchronous invocations only. Reassess if asynchronous invocation is introduced.

The handler returns only in-memory synthetic inventory and has no network calls or private resources. VPC attachment adds subnet, security-group and ENI requirements without protecting a data connection. Reassess if private dependencies or real data are introduced.

rules_to_suppress.reason: This synchronous synthetic fixture has no network calls or private resources. A VPC and ENI permissions are unnecessary; reassess if the handler gains private dependencies or real data.

StockLogs is pre-created by CloudFormation and StockFunction explicitly depends on it. StockExecutionRole grants logs:CreateLogStream and logs:PutLogEvents only on that group's streams; logs:CreateLogGroup is deliberately unnecessary.

PartsFunctionArn.Description: Use as the Gateway Lambda target ARN.
